text:
Type: round metal tray table
Use: holding drinks, a plant or books, serving with a lift-off tray; living room, bedroom, balcony
Style: contemporary, retro, minimalist
Materials: powder-coated steel, removable tray top
Colors: pale butter yellow
Shape: round lift-off tray with a raised rim, four thin straight rod legs, cross brace near the floor, compact and light, open silhouette
Feel: cheerful, light, playful, airy
Goes with: white or pastel rooms, light wood, rattan and plants; Scandinavian, bohemian or modern living rooms and balconies
